**Section 80EEA – Additional interest deduction on affordable‑housing loans (FY 2023‑24)**  

| Condition | Legal source |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Maximum deduction** – The amount of interest that can be claimed under 80EEA is limited to **₹ 1,50,000** in a financial year. | [C1] |
| **Loan purpose** – The deduction is available only on interest paid on a **loan taken for the purchase or construction of a residential house property**. | [C2] |
| **Affordable‑housing ceiling** – The residential property must have a **stamp‑duty value not exceeding ₹ 45 lakhs**. | [C5] |
| **Mutual exclusivity with Section 80EE** – If a deduction is claimed under 80EEA, **no deduction can be claimed under 80EE** (and vice‑versa). Only one of the two sections may be availed. | [C3] |
| **Regime restriction** – The deduction under 80EEA is **available only when the taxpayer opts for the “Old” tax regime**. Under the “New” tax regime the deduction must be zero. | [C7] & [C8] & [C4] |
| **Other conditions (sub‑section 3 of 80EEA)** – The amount is subject to the additional conditions specified in **sub‑section (3) of Section 80EEA** (e.g., the loan must be taken from a financial institution, the loan amount must not exceed a prescribed limit, the property must be self‑occupied, etc.). While the exact wording of sub‑section (3) is not reproduced in the supplied chunks, the reference to it is explicit. | [C1] & [C2] |
| **Documentation** – Details of the loan (bank name, loan amount, etc.) must be furnished in the I‑TR schedule for claiming the deduction. | [C6] & [C7] & [C8] |

### Summary of the conditions
1. **Interest paid on a loan for a self‑occupied residential house** whose **stamp‑duty value ≤ ₹ 45 lakhs**.  
2. **Maximum claim ₹ 1,50,000** per year.  
3. **Only one of the two housing‑interest deductions (80EE or 80EEA) may be claimed**; if 80EEA is claimed, 80EE is excluded.  
4. **Applicable only under the Old tax regime**; the New regime does not permit any amount under 80EEA.  
5. **Compliance with the detailed conditions of sub‑section (3) of Section 80EEA** (loan from a financial institution, loan amount limits, property must be self‑occupied, etc.).  
6. **Proper loan details must be entered in the I‑TR schedule** to validate the claim.
